metadata.title: Cauliflower Bai | Mizo Style Cauliflower Florets & Stalk boil
metadata.description:
Northeast Indian cuisine is known largely for its non-vegetarian dishes and though we live up to our reputation, we do love our vegetables too. 

Mizoram has some pretty amazing cuisine and one of my favorite Mizo dish is the vegetable bai the best part of it is that it is simple and easy to make. 

A bai is made by boiling seasonal vegetables in lots of water,  with a little cooked rice, salt and cooking soda. It's served hot with the meals.
